newsitem.title: USA: Biocircuits gets U.S. FDA OK for assay.
newsitem.headline: Biocircuits gets U.S. FDA OK for assay.

text.p: Biocircuits Corp said Wednesday it got clearance from the U.S. Food & Drug Administration to market its Quantitative hCG assay.
The assay will be offered with Biocircuit's IOS immunodiagnostic system to allow testing in physicians' offices and other care centers.

"The assay is designed to allow physicians to track the progress of early pregnancies," said John Kaiser, President and Chief Executive Officer of Biocircuits. "The quantitative hCG assay expands further the testing capabilities of our IOS system," he said.
Biocircuits said it plans to launch the assay on the second generation cartridge late in the first quarter of 1997 or early in the second quarter.
